method.tool_version: ffmpeg version 8.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
method.measurement: Entire decoded first audio stream; 100ms metadata interval; momentary400ms and short-term3s; percentiles exclude first3s warmup. No playback or source separation.
method.true_peak_precision: Metadata linear peak rounded to0.001 by FFmpeg; dBTP derived as20log10(value), so near-threshold precision is limited.

pilot_stem_alignment.comparison: native-normalized versus score-bed at same100ms timeline index; native contains narration and generated ambience/effects, not an isolated voice stem.
pilot_stem_alignment.active_native_proxy_rule: native momentary loudness > -30LUFS; a signal-level proxy, not voice activity detection or speech transcription.

limits: Reference files are cached delivered compressed mixes; original stems, mastering settings and playback normalization are unavailable.
Full-mix LUFS cannot establish music-versus-voice balance or narrator identity/cadence.
Momentary low-level fractions are not speech pause fractions; music and ambience remain present.
No audible listening, ASR, paid analysis, generation or video rerender.

quieter_music_correction.status: Local PCM assets created; main export untouched. Parent owns remux and delivery.
